citation: Example A (2019), City wage floors and teenage employment
question: Does a city-level wage floor reduce teenage employment?
design: Two-way fixed effects DiD on a county-year panel, 2004 reform
finding: Teen employment falls 3.2%, effect concentrated in small firms

citation: Example B (2020), Bunching at the wage floor
question: Do firms bunch jobs just above the new floor?
finding: Employment mass shifts up 4.1% just above the floor

citation: Example C (2021), Wage floors and firm exit
question: Do wage floors push small firms to exit?
design: Event study around county increases with firm entry and exit
finding: Small-firm exit rises 1.8% in treated counties

citation: Example D (2022), Spillovers to workers above the floor
question: Do wage floors raise pay above the minimum?
design: RDD on the wage distribution with a local linear estimator
finding: Wages 6.5% higher up to the 40th percentile
